description: Show the cached fit-analysis context a tailored CV should reframe toward: verdict, recommendation, dimension comments, and the requirement split — missing_have (reframe existing evidence) vs missing_gap (ask the candidate before adding). Read this before editing.

id.description: The CV id, from cv_tailor or cv_list (or the tailoring workspace URL /tailor/<job>?cv=<id>). Opaque — never construct or guess one.
